(function executeRule(current, previous /* null when async */ ) {
    try {
        gs.info('AMENDCONF: Rule execution started for trade_id: ' + current.trade_id);

        var ghss = new x_hsb11_mss_c_ghss.GHSS_Helper();
        var req;

        // Fetching BulkId
        var bulkId;
        var tradeTaskGr = new GlideRecord("x_hsb11_mss_c_proc_mss_custody_task");
        tradeTaskGr.addEncodedQuery("trade_id.sys_idSTARTSWITH" + current.sys_id);
        tradeTaskGr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        tradeTaskGr.setLimit(1);
        tradeTaskGr.query();
        if (tradeTaskGr.next()) {
            bulkId = tradeTaskGr.bulk_id;
            gs.info('AMENDCONF: Fetched bulkId: ' + bulkId);
        } else {
            gs.info('AMENDCONF: No bulkId found for trade_id: ' + current.sys_id);
        }

        // Fetching active case
        var caseId;
        var caseGr = new GlideRecord("x_hsb11_mss_c_proc_mss_custody_case");
        caseGr.addQuery("trade_id", current.sys_id);
        caseGr.addQuery("active", true);
        caseGr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        caseGr.setLimit(1);
        caseGr.query();
        if (caseGr.next()) {
            caseId = caseGr.sys_id;
            gs.info('AMENDCONF: Fetched active caseId: ' + caseId);
        } else {
            gs.info('AMENDCONF: No active case found for trade_id: ' + current.sys_id);
        }

        // var getTrade = new GlideRecord("x_hsb11_mss_custod_mss_custody_business_process_instance");
        // getTrade.addEncodedQuery("trade_id.sys_idSTARTSWITH" + current.sys_id);
        // getTrade.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        // getTrade.setLimit(1);
        // getTrade.query();
        // if (getTrade.next()) {
        //     var custodyCase = new GlideRecord("x_hsb11_mss_c_proc_mss_custody_case");
        //     custodyCase.initialize();
        //     custodyCase.short_description = "Investigate " + getTrade.core_stage_reference.status;
        //     custodyCase.description = "This case is created when a " + getTrade.core_stage_reference.status + " status is received. This case will remain open until a new trade lifecycle status is received.";
        //     custodyCase.triggered_by = getTrade.core_stage_reference;
        //     custodyCase.u_fo_process_status = getTrade.core_stage_reference;
        //     custodyCase.u_object_type = getTrade.object_type;
        //     custodyCase.trade_id = getTrade.trade_id; // <-- Use the trade reference, not the process instance sys_id
        //     custodyCase.u_business_process_instance = getTrade.sys_id;
        //     custodyCase.u_source = getTrade.source_system;
        //     var caseId = custodyCase.insert();
        //     gs.info('AMENDCONF: New custody case created for CONF: ' + caseId);

        //     getTrade.is_case_created_core = true;
        //     getTrade.case_counter++;
        //     getTrade.update();
        //     gs.info('AMENDCONF: Updated trade record for switch trade: ' + getTrade.sys_id);

        //     new x_hsb11_mss_c_proc.MSSCustodyBulkUtils().updateAutomatedManulTask(getTrade.trade_id, caseId);
        //     new x_hsb11_mss_c_proc.MSSCustodyBulkUtils().setTradeCaseType(getTrade.trade_id, 'automated'); // <-- Use trade_id
        // }

        // Initializing Confirm Handler
        var confirmTask = new GlideRecord('x_hsb11_mss_c_proc_mss_custody_task');
        confirmTask.initialize();
        confirmTask.trade_task_template_id = 'CUSTODYTTMP00129';
        confirmTask.trade_task_type = 'GHSS Handler - Confirm';
        confirmTask.short_description = 'Widget Update Handler - Confirm Automation';
        confirmTask.description = 'This Task has been triggered to automatically perform an action on the trade in Widget';
        confirmTask.trade_id = current.sys_id;
        confirmTask.bulk_id = bulkId;
        confirmTask.trade_case_id = caseId;
        confirmTask.advice = 'Y';
        confirmTask.amend_checker_decision = 'AMEND_CONF';
        confirmTask.assignment_group = 'f1a78cb61b9cb950ff37eb14b24bcb85';
        var confirmTaskSysId = confirmTask.insert();
        gs.info('AMENDCONF: Confirm handler task created ' + confirmTask.number + 'confirm task case id - ' + confirmTask.trade_case_id.number + 'confirm task bulk id - ' + confirmTask.bulk_id.number);

        var taskTrade = current.sys_id; //trade ID of Confirm Widget same trade
        var amendTradeID = current.trade_id;
        var confirmWidgetSysID = confirmTask.sys_id;
        gs.info('AMENDCONF: taskTrade, amendTradeID and ConfirmWidgetSysID - ' + taskTrade + ', ' + amendTradeID + 'and' + confirmWidgetSysID);

        var amendhandlerAdvice = confirmTask.advice.toString();

        // MakerCheckerID for Amend and CONF
        var getMakerChecker = new GlideRecord("x_hsb11_mss_c_proc_mss_custody_task");
        getMakerChecker.addEncodedQuery("trade_case_id.sys_idSTARTSWITH" + caseId + "^trade_task_type=Maker");
        getMakerChecker.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        getMakerChecker.query();
        var amendcheckerId, amendmakerId;
        if (getMakerChecker.next()) {
            var amendcheckerName = getMakerChecker.trade_case_id.current_checker_assignee.user_name.toString();
            amendcheckerId = amendcheckerName.slice(0, 8);
            var amendmakerName = getMakerChecker.trade_case_id.current_maker_assignee.user_name.toString();
            amendmakerId = amendmakerName.slice(0, 8);
            gs.info('AMENDCONF: MakerChecker found. Maker: ' + amendmakerId + ', Checker: ' + amendcheckerId);
        } else {
            gs.info('AMENDCONF: No MakerChecker found for caseId: ' + caseId);
        }

        // Finding the latest eventTIme
        var unityTimeStamp;
        var getExisitingPCON = new GlideRecord("x_hsb11_mss_custod_mss_custody_event_inbound_staging");
        getExisitingPCON.addEncodedQuery("object_idSTARTSWITH" + amendTradeID.toString() + "^legacy_status=PCON^processing_statusINprocessed_created,processed_updated");
        getExisitingPCON.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        getExisitingPCON.setLimit(1);
        getExisitingPCON.query();
        if (getExisitingPCON.next()) {
            var payloadStr = getExisitingPCON.trade_details;
            gs.info('AMENDCONF: Raw payloadStr: ' + payloadStr);
            if (payloadStr) {
                try {
                    var payloadObj = JSON.parse(payloadStr);
                    unityTimeStamp = payloadObj.SourceSystemLastUpdatedDateTime;
                    gs.info('AMENDCONF: Found latest event timestamp: ' + unityTimeStamp);
                } catch (e) {
                    gs.error('AMENDCONF: JSON parse error: ' + e.message);
                }
            } else {
                gs.error('AMENDCONF: trade_details is empty for event: ' + getExisitingPCON.sys_id);
            }
        } else {
            gs.error('AMENDCONF: No PCON event found for trade_id: ' + amendTradeID);
        }

        makerId = amendmakerId;
        checkerId = amendcheckerId;
        tradeReference = amendTradeID;
        sourceSystemTimeStamp = unityTimeStamp;
        adviceType = amendhandlerAdvice;

        req = '{ "request_type" : "confirm_ghss", "servicenowid" : "' + confirmTaskSysId + '", "maker" : "' + makerId + '", "checker" : "' + checkerId + '", "reference" : "' + tradeReference + '" , "last_update_date_time": "' + sourceSystemTimeStamp + '", "generate_advice":"' + adviceType + '"  }';
        gs.info('AMENDCONF: Sending outbound GHSS request: ' + req);

        ghss.ghssScriptedUpdateOutbound(req);

        //update trade status to empty after req is sent

        var tradeGr = new GlideRecord('x_hsb11_mss_c_proc_mss_custody_trade');
        if (tradeGr.get(taskTrade)) {
            tradeGr.status = '';
            tradeGr.update();
            gs.info('AMENDCONF: Trade status cleared after outbound call.');
        }



        // --------------------------------------------------------------------In case of switch - create a case and task for switch trade-----------------------------------------------------------------
        if (bulkId && bulkId.transaction_reference && bulkId.transaction_reference.legacy_status == 'PCON' && bulkId.sub_outcome == 'Pair Trade') {
            gs.info('AMENDCONF: Switch trade detected, starting switch trade logic.');

            var tradeSysID = bulkId.transaction_reference.sys_id;

            var getTrade = new GlideRecord("x_hsb11_mss_custod_mss_custody_business_process_instance");
            getTrade.addEncodedQuery("trade_id.sys_idSTARTSWITH" + tradeSysID);
            getTrade.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
            getTrade.setLimit(1);
            getTrade.query();

            // Closing existing case on switch trade
            var getCase = new GlideRecord('x_hsb11_mss_c_proc_mss_custody_case');
            getCase.addEncodedQuery('trade_id.sys_idSTARTSWITH' + tradeSysID);
            getCase.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
            getCase.setLimit(1);
            getCase.query();
            if (getCase.next()) {
                getCase.state = 3;
                getCase.active = false;
                getCase.update();
                gs.info('AMENDCONF: Closed existing case for switch trade: ' + getCase.sys_id);
            }

            if (getTrade.next()) {
                var custodyCase = new GlideRecord("x_hsb11_mss_c_proc_mss_custody_case");
                custodyCase.initialize();
                custodyCase.short_description = "Investigate " + getTrade.core_stage_reference.status;
                custodyCase.description = "This case is created when a " + getTrade.core_stage_reference.status + " status is received. This case will remain open until a new trade lifecycle status is received.";
                custodyCase.triggered_by = getTrade.core_stage_reference;
                custodyCase.u_fo_process_status = getTrade.core_stage_reference;
                custodyCase.u_object_type = getTrade.object_type;
                custodyCase.trade_id = getTrade.trade_id;
                custodyCase.u_business_process_instance = getTrade.sys_id;
                custodyCase.u_source = getTrade.source_system;
                var newobjectid = custodyCase.insert();
                gs.info('AMENDCONF: New switch custody case created: ' + newobjectid);

                getTrade.is_case_created_core = true;
                getTrade.case_counter++;
                getTrade.update();
                gs.info('AMENDCONF: Updated trade record for switch trade: ' + getTrade.sys_id);

                new x_hsb11_mss_c_proc.MSSCustodyBulkUtils().updateAutomatedManulTask(getTrade.trade_id, newobjectid);
                new x_hsb11_mss_c_proc.MSSCustodyBulkUtils().setTradeCaseType(getTrade.trade_id, 'automated');
            }

            // Initializing Confirm Handler for switch
            var confirmTask2 = new GlideRecord('x_hsb11_mss_c_proc_mss_custody_task');
            confirmTask2.initialize();
            confirmTask2.trade_task_template_id = 'CUSTODYTTMP00129';
            confirmTask2.trade_task_type = 'GHSS Handler - Confirm';
            confirmTask2.short_description = 'Widget Update Handler - Confirm Automation';
            confirmTask2.description = 'This Task has been triggered to automatically perform an action on the trade in Widget';
            confirmTask2.trade_id = current.trade_id;
            confirmTask2.bulk_id = bulkId;
            confirmTask2.trade_case_id = newobjectid;
            confirmTask2.advice = 'Y';
            confirmTask2.amend_checker_decision = 'AMEND_CONF';
            confirmTask2.assignment_group = 'f1a78cb61b9cb950ff37eb14b24bcb85';
            var confirmTask2SysId = confirmTask2.insert();
            gs.info('AMENDCONF: Confirm handler task for switch created with sys_id: ' + confirmTask2SysId);

            // MakerCheckerID for Amend and CONF (switch)
            var getMakerChecker2 = new GlideRecord("x_hsb11_mss_c_proc_mss_custody_task");
            getMakerChecker2.addEncodedQuery("trade_case_id.sys_idSTARTSWITH" + caseId + "^trade_task_type=Maker");
            getMakerChecker2.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
            getMakerChecker2.query();
            var amendcheckerId2, amendmakerId2;
            if (getMakerChecker2.next()) {
                var amendcheckerName2 = getMakerChecker2.trade_case_id.current_checker_assignee.user_name.toString();
                amendcheckerId2 = amendcheckerName2.slice(0, 8);
                var amendmakerName2 = getMakerChecker2.trade_case_id.current_maker_assignee.user_name.toString();
                amendmakerId2 = amendmakerName2.slice(0, 8);
                gs.info('AMENDCONF: Switch MakerChecker found. Maker: ' + amendmakerId2 + ', Checker: ' + amendcheckerId2);
            } else {
                gs.info('AMENDCONF: No MakerChecker found for switch caseId: ' + caseId);
            }

            // Finding the latest eventTIme (switch)
            var unityTimeStamp2;
            var getExisitingPCON2 = new GlideRecord("x_hsb11_mss_custod_mss_custody_event_inbound_staging");
            getExisitingPCON2.addEncodedQuery("object_idSTARTSWITH" + tradeSysID.toString() + "^legacy_status=PCON^processing_statusINprocessed_created,processed_updated");
            getExisitingPCON2.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
            getExisitingPCON2.setLimit(1);
            getExisitingPCON2.query();
            if (getExisitingPCON2.next()) {
                var payloadStr2 = getExisitingPCON2.trade_details;
                var payloadObj2 = JSON.parse(payloadStr2);
                unityTimeStamp2 = payloadObj2.SourceSystemLastUpdatedDateTime;
                gs.info('AMENDCONF: Switch latest event timestamp: ' + unityTimeStamp2);
            } else {
                gs.info('AMENDCONF: No PCON event found for switch trade_id: ' + tradeSysID);
            }

            // Replacing as per amend and CONF (switch)
            var makerId2 = amendmakerId2;
            var checkerId2 = amendcheckerId2;
            var tradeReference2 = tradeSysID;
            var sourceSystemTimeStamp2 = unityTimeStamp2;
            var adviceType2 = amendhandlerAdvice;

            var req2 = '{ "request_type" : "confirm_ghss", "servicenowid" : "' + confirmTask2.sys_id + '", "maker" : "' + makerId2 + '", "checker" : "' + checkerId2 + '", "reference" : "' + tradeReference2 + '" , "last_update_date_time": "' + sourceSystemTimeStamp2 + '", "generate_advice":"' + adviceType2 + '"  }';
            gs.info('AMENDCONF: Sending outbound GHSS request for switch: ' + req2);

            ghss.ghssScriptedUpdateOutbound(req2);



            var tradeGr = new GlideRecord('x_hsb11_mss_c_proc_mss_custody_trade');
            if (tradeGr.get(tradeSysID)) {
                tradeGr.status = '';
                tradeGr.update();
                gs.info('AMENDCONF: switch Trade status cleared after outbound call.');
            }
        }
        // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------End switch logic--------------------------------------------------------------------------

        gs.info('AMENDCONF: Rule execution completed for trade_id: ' + current.trade_id);

    } catch (e) {
        gs.error('AMENDCONF: Error in BR executeRule: ' + e.message);
        if (e.stack) {
            gs.error('AMENDCONF: Stack trace: ' + e.stack);
        }
    }
})(current, previous);
sys_script.name: MSS Amend/Switch Confirm handler
